paper.title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
paper.read_scope: sections 2.1-2.4 and 3.1-3.2: affine zero point, integer accumulators, simulated training, range observations

author_code.officiality: Library and documentation explicitly referenced by the original paper

tool.officiality: PyTorch framework, not reproduction of original TensorFlow paper code
tool.license: BSD-3-Clause root LICENSE read at fixed commit
tool.reuse: existing installed public APIs; no new dependency or global backend change

adaptation: CPU partial-layer PTQ/QAT; per-output-channel symmetric signed weights and affine activations; reduced 0..127 input range for x86 saturation safety; output 0..255; FP32 bias and quantize/dequantize boundaries. Independent adapter, not integer-only whole-model reproduction.
limits: caller role strings do not authenticate data provenance; whole-model manifest binding and real class protection belong to next stage
